Elo Ratings vs Matrix Rankings - Season 2026

Report Generated: Review-only comparison of Elo ratings against matrix rankings

Purpose: Validate four-tier hybrid ranking system

Tier A: Matrix ranks 1-60 (boys) or 1-36 (girls) use Matrix Rank as Proposed Rank

Tier B: Matrix rank > cutoff, wins >= 1, ordered by Elo Score (descending)

Tier C: Matrix rank > cutoff, wins == 0 AND losses > 0, ordered by Elo Score (descending), always below Tier B

Tier D: matches == 0 (0-0 record), always at absolute bottom
